newsitem.title: DENMARK: Buoyant Danish shares poised for new record highs.
newsitem.headline: Buoyant Danish shares poised for new record highs.

text.p: Danish share prices opened higher on Friday, with dealers seeing the top-20 KFX index breaking new records after the overnight Dow rise.
"The market is strong with leading banks, notably Unidanmark and BG Bank, and energy and shipping group Moeller providing the basis for more rises after yesterday's gains," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.41 point to 183.70 at 0705 GMT, having closed 2.81 point higher on Thursday at a new all-time closing high for the eighth consecutive trading day.
